text.content:
The fixer who put a rulebook together for the new crop.

Role: Fixer
Where to find them: Watson and Kabuki
Known for: Editing the 2070 edgerunner's rulebook; the margin notes on the NCZTA-70 threat dossier

A fixer working Watson and Kabuki who thinks in eddies and favors. In 2070 she put together a rulebook for the new crop of edgerunners, enlisting Fury, Lattice, Doc Mags and Stop Sign to write their parts, and paid Lyle Thompson to write the city to go with it, because every map out there was wrong. She annotated the leaked NCZTA-70 threat-zone dossier.

Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules, ch.00; Night City 2070, ch.00
